name: Tool — Foundry IQ (1P MCP)
summary: Microsoft 1P MCP server: Foundry IQ. Attached via MCPTool with AgenticIdentity auth.
description: The **Foundry IQ** first-party MCP server exposes Microsoft Foundry's own knowledge (docs, samples, model catalog) as a tool. Attached to a BYOM Prompt Agent so the agent can answer 'how do I do X in Foundry?' with citations.
notes: Foundry IQ is on the official BYOM-supported tools list (`https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/agents/how-to/ai-gateway#supported-configurations` — '1P MCP servers: Foundry IQ, SharePoint Grounding, Fabric Data Agent'). **Not yet probed against Foundry** — the test wires it via `make_mcp_tool(url=FOUNDRY_IQ_MCP_URL, label='foundry_iq')` and skips with `::warning::` if `FOUNDRY_IQ_MCP_URL` is unset. Set the env var to run.
